paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah, son of Rabbi Sichon.

Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 94:9. This is a scribal error: it should read Rabbi Yehudah, son of Rabbi Simon, as in Midrash Shmuel, chapter 32: Rabbi Azaryah in the name of Rabbi Yehudah, son of Rabbi Simon.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Midrash Shmuel paragraph reads Rabbi Azaryah in the name of Rabbi Yehudah bar Rabbi Simon. This supplies the report formula compressed in Hyman’s quotation.

Both consulted passages, Bereshit Rabbah 94:9 and Midrash Shmuel 32, have Rabbi Azaryah reporting in the name of Rabbi Yehudah beRabbi Simon. This supports the report formula rather than making Azaryah a son of Yehudah. The supplied Sichon heading and Hyman's assertion that it SHOULD READ Simon are retained; no printed correction history or origin of the supplied spelling is established.
